jp: 聡明なパルミアの王。民を思う心を強く持って善政を布くが、それゆえ自国民を危険に晒す危険性のある選択肢に対しては、必要以上に慎重になり過ぎるきらいがある。
jp_grezzo: "聡明なパルミアの王。民を思う心を強く持って善政を布くが、それゆえ自国民を危険に晒す危険性のある選択肢に対しては、必要以上に慎重になり過ぎるきらいがある。"
en: Wise king of Palmia. He is a benevolent ruler with a strong sense of duty to his people, but he tends to be more cautious than necessary about choices that might endanger his own people.
en_grezzo: "Wise king of Palmia. He is a benevolent ruler with a strong sense of duty to his people, but he tends to be more cautious than necessary about choices that might endanger his own people. "
it: Il saggio re di Palmia. Ha a cuore il suo popolo e governa con giustizia, ma proprio per questo, davanti a una scelta che rischi di esporre i suoi al pericolo, tende a essere prudente più del necessario.

jp: かつては白い肌の美しいエレアのような見た目の種族だった。邪悪な存在に堕落させられて現在の姿になったと言われている。
jp_grezzo: "かつては白い肌の美しいエレアのような見た目の種族だった。邪悪な存在に堕落させられて現在の姿になったと言われている。"
en: At one time, these were a beautiful pale-skinned tribe of people similar to the Elea. It is said that their current appearance is due to being corrupted by wicked thoughts.
en_grezzo: "At one time, these were a beautiful pale-skinned tribe of people similar to the Elea. It is said that their current appearance is due to being corrupted by wicked thoughts."
it: Un tempo erano una stirpe dalla pelle bianca e dall'aspetto bello, simile a quello degli Elea. Si dice che una presenza malvagia li abbia corrotti e ridotti come sono adesso.

jp: 硬い鱗の肌を持つ竜人の戦士。武器や防具を扱う知性を持ち、独自の文化を築いているが、好戦的で他種族との交流はあまり無い。
jp_grezzo: "硬い鱗の肌を持つ竜人の戦士。武器や防具を扱う知性を持ち、独自の文化を築いているが、好戦的で他種族との交流はあまり無い。"
en: A dragonborn warrior with hard scaly skin. They have the intelligence to handle weapons and armour and have developed their own culture, but are belligerent and do not interact much with other races.
en_grezzo: "A dragonborn warrior with hard scaly skin. They have the intelligence to handle weapons and armour and have developed their own culture, but are belligerent and do not interact much with other races. "
it: Un guerriero uomo lucertola dalla pelle coperta di scaglie dure. Ha l'intelligenza per maneggiare armi e armature e si è costruito una cultura sua, ma è bellicoso e con le altre stirpi non ha molti scambi.

jp: すさまじい筋肉と体力を誇る牛人。自慢の体力にものを言わせ、手にした獲物を振るうことで幾人もの冒険者を挽き肉にしてきた。
jp_grezzo: "すさまじい筋肉と体力を誇る牛人。自慢の体力にものを言わせ、手にした獲物を振るうことで幾人もの冒険者を挽き肉にしてきた。"
en: A bullfighter with tremendous muscle and strength. He has turned many adventurers into ground meat by using his physical strength to wield the prey in his hands.
en_grezzo: "A bullfighter with tremendous muscle and strength. He has turned many adventurers into ground meat by using his physical strength to wield the prey in his hands. "
it: Un uomo toro che vanta muscoli e vigore spaventosi. Facendo parlare quel fisico di cui va fiero, con l'arma che si ritrova in mano ha ridotto a carne trita più di un avventuriero.

jp: 牛頭ながら必死に勉強し、ファイアボルトを始めとする簡単な魔法を習得した。呪いの言葉は頭のいい冒険者に対する嫉妬らしい。
jp_grezzo: "牛頭ながら必死に勉強し、ファイアボルトを始めとする簡単な魔法を習得した。呪いの言葉は頭のいい冒険者に対する嫉妬らしい。"
en: Despite being a cow-head, he studied hard and learnt simple magic, including firebolt. His curse word seems to be jealousy of smart adventurers.
en_grezzo: "Despite being a cow-head, he studied hard and learnt simple magic, including firebolt. His curse word seems to be jealousy of smart adventurers. "
it: Con una testa da bue si è messo a studiare con tutte le forze e ha imparato qualche magia semplice, a cominciare dalla saetta di fuoco. Le parolacce che gli escono pare siano invidia verso gli avventurieri intelligenti.

jp: 武器を使わずに己のコブシのみで戦えるまでに至った闘士。しかし愛用の斧がないと落ち着かないので結局いつも携行している。
jp_grezzo: "武器を使わずに己のコブシのみで戦えるまでに至った闘士。しかし愛用の斧がないと落ち着かないので結局いつも携行している。"
en: A fighter who has reached the point where he can fight without weapons, using only his knob. However, he is uncomfortable without his favourite axe, which he carries with him at all times.
en_grezzo: "A fighter who has reached the point where he can fight without weapons, using only his knob. However, he is uncomfortable without his favourite axe, which he carries with him at all times. "
it: Un lottatore arrivato al punto di sapersi battere con i soli pugni, senza armi. Solo che senza l'ascia a cui è affezionato non sta tranquillo, e alla fine se la porta sempre dietro.

jp: 凄まじい筋肉と体力を誇る牛人の戦士。戦士として修練を重ねたミノタウロスの自由自在に振るわれる鈍器は、唸り声を上げながら敵を粉砕する。
jp_grezzo: "凄まじい筋肉と体力を誇る牛人の戦士。戦士として修練を重ねたミノタウロスの自由自在に振るわれる鈍器は、唸り声を上げながら敵を粉砕する。"
en: A bullfighter who boasts tremendous muscle and physical strength. Trained as warriors, the freely wielded blunt weapons of the minotaurs crush their enemies with a roar.
en_grezzo: "A bullfighter who boasts tremendous muscle and physical strength. Trained as warriors, the freely wielded blunt weapons of the minotaurs crush their enemies with a roar. "
it: Un guerriero uomo toro che vanta muscoli e vigore spaventosi. La mazza che un minotauro addestrato come guerriero rigira a piacimento fa a pezzi il nemico con un boato.

jp: 野蛮なミノタウロスたちを束ねる王。屈強な体格と恐るべき破壊力の斧で、敵の肉体と戦う意志を完膚なきまでに破壊する。王都への侵攻を企てているが、自分の巣で迷子になっており外に出られない。
jp_grezzo: "野蛮なミノタウロスたちを束ねる王。屈強な体格と恐るべき破壊力の斧で、敵の肉体と戦う意志を完膚なきまでに破壊する。王都への侵攻を企てているが、自分の巣で迷子になっており外に出られない。"
en: King who unites the savage minotaurs. With his mighty physique and fearsome destructive axe, he utterly destroys the bodies and will to fight of his enemies. He plans to invade the royal capital, but is lost in his own lair and unable to get out.
en_grezzo: "King who unites the savage minotaurs. With his mighty physique and fearsome destructive axe, he utterly destroys the bodies and will to fight of his enemies. He plans to invade the royal capital, but is lost in his own lair and unable to get out."
it: Il re che tiene insieme i minotauri selvaggi. Con quel fisico possente e con l'ascia dalla potenza distruttiva spaventosa annienta il corpo del nemico e la sua voglia di combattere. Sta preparando l'assalto alla capitale, ma nella propria tana si è perso e non riesce a uscire.

jp: 巨大な体躯を持つ亜人の一種。再生力の高さが有名で、小さな傷ならすぐ治る。その秘密は特殊な血液にあると言われている。
jp_grezzo: "巨大な体躯を持つ亜人の一種。再生力の高さが有名で、小さな傷ならすぐ治る。その秘密は特殊な血液にあると言われている。"
en: A type of subhuman with a gigantic physique. They are famous for their regenerative powers and can quickly heal small wounds. The secret is said to lie in its special blood.
en_grezzo: "A type of subhuman with a gigantic physique. They are famous for their regenerative powers and can quickly heal small wounds. The secret is said to lie in its special blood."
it: Una specie affine all'uomo, dal corpo gigantesco. È famoso per la capacità di rigenerarsi: le ferite piccole gli si rimarginano subito. Il segreto, dicono, sta in un sangue speciale.

jp: ネフィアで暮らすエレアの民。迫害され町を追い出されたため、ネフィアの外からやってくる人物に対して恨みを抱いている。武装はネフィアで暮らすため仕方なくしているそうだ。
jp_grezzo: "ネフィアで暮らすエレアの民。迫害され町を追い出されたため、ネフィアの外からやってくる人物に対して恨みを抱いている。武装はネフィアで暮らすため仕方なくしているそうだ。"
en: An Elea who lives within ruins of Nefia. Because they were persecuted and exiled from their villages, they bear a grudge against those who enter the ruins. Their armaments are a natural consequence of having to live within the ruins.
en_grezzo: "An Elea who lives within ruins of Nefia. Because they were persecuted and exiled from their villages, they bear a grudge against those who enter the ruins. Their armaments are a natural consequence of having to live within the ruins."
it: Un Elea che vive nelle Nefia. Perseguitati e cacciati dalle città, portano rancore a chi arriva da fuori. Le armi, a quanto pare, se le porta per forza, perché nelle Nefia bisogna pur viverci.

jp: ネフィアで暮らすエレアの民。迫害され町を追い出されたため、仕方なく雨風をしのげるネフィアで暮らしている。警戒心が強く、見慣れない相手はエレアだろうと攻撃する。
jp_grezzo: "ネフィアで暮らすエレアの民。迫害され町を追い出されたため、仕方なく雨風をしのげるネフィアで暮らしている。警戒心が強く、見慣れない相手はエレアだろうと攻撃する。"
en: Elea folks living inside Nefia. Persecuted and forced out of their town, they have no choice but to live in Nefia, where they can shelter from the wind and rain. They are very wary and will attack anyone unfamiliar to them, even if they are Elea.
en_grezzo: "Elea folks living inside Nefia. Persecuted and forced out of their town, they have no choice but to live in Nefia, where they can shelter from the wind and rain. They are very wary and will attack anyone unfamiliar to them, even if they are Elea."
it: Un Elea che vive nelle Nefia. Perseguitati e cacciati dalle città, non hanno altra scelta che vivere nelle Nefia, dove almeno ci si ripara dal vento e dalla pioggia. Sono molto diffidenti, e chi non conoscono lo attaccano anche se è un Elea.

jp: 古の火の神の欠片を宿した好戦的な魔物。多手それぞれに武器を持ち、狂ったように敵対者を切り刻む。手に意識を集中しすぎて足元がお留守になることも。
jp_grezzo: "古の火の神の欠片を宿した好戦的な魔物。多手それぞれに武器を持ち、狂ったように敵対者を切り刻む。手に意識を集中しすぎて足元がお留守になることも。"
en: A belligerent demon that bears the shards of an ancient fire god. It holds a weapon in each of its many hands, and madly chops up its opponents. Sometimes concentrates too much on his hands, leaving his feet unattended.
en_grezzo: "A belligerent demon that bears the shards of an ancient fire god. It holds a weapon in each of its many hands, and madly chops up its opponents. Sometimes concentrates too much on his hands, leaving his feet unattended."
it: Un mostro bellicoso in cui alberga il frammento dell'antico dio del fuoco. Tiene un'arma in ciascuna delle sue molte mani e fa a pezzi chi gli si oppone come un pazzo. A volte concentra troppo l'attenzione sulle mani e si dimentica dei piedi.

jp: 古の太陽の神の欠片を宿した魔物。この太陽神の祭祀が、現在のジュア祭に影響を与えたと唱える歴史家もいる。なぜ緑色なのかはその歴史家にもわからないそうだが。
jp_grezzo: "古の太陽の神の欠片を宿した魔物。この太陽神の祭祀が、現在のジュア祭に影響を与えたと唱える歴史家もいる。なぜ緑色なのかはその歴史家にもわからないそうだが。"
en: A demon that inhabits a piece of the ancient sun god. Some historians claim that the rituals of this sun god influenced the present day Jua festival. Why it is green, though, is said to be unknown to those historians.
en_grezzo: "A demon that inhabits a piece of the ancient sun god. Some historians claim that the rituals of this sun god influenced the present day Jua festival. Why it is green, though, is said to be unknown to those historians."
it: Un mostro in cui alberga il frammento dell'antico dio del sole. C'è chi, fra gli storici, sostiene che il culto di questo dio del sole abbia influenzato la festa di Jure di oggi. Perché però sia verde, pare che nemmeno quegli storici lo sappiano.

jp: 古の天空と秩序の神の欠片を宿した魔物。水を統べる能力も失われて久しく、この異形は目前の敵を物理的に殲滅するだけに、美しい腕を旋回させる。
jp_grezzo: "古の天空と秩序の神の欠片を宿した魔物。水を統べる能力も失われて久しく、この異形は目前の敵を物理的に殲滅するだけに、美しい腕を旋回させる。"
en: A demon that bears the fragments of an ancient god of sky and order. The ability to govern the waters has long since been lost, and this variant swivels its beautiful arms only to physically annihilate the enemy in front of it.
en_grezzo: "A demon that bears the fragments of an ancient god of sky and order. The ability to govern the waters has long since been lost, and this variant swivels its beautiful arms only to physically annihilate the enemy in front of it. "
it: Un mostro in cui albergano i frammenti dell'antico dio del cielo e dell'ordine. Il potere di governare le acque l'ha perso da un pezzo, e questa creatura deforme fa roteare le sue belle braccia soltanto per annientare fisicamente il nemico che ha davanti.

jp: 精霊と心を通わせ、神々の力の輪廻をひもとき生きる識者。厳然たる基礎事実の積み重ねを重視する科学者と対立する事が多い。
jp_grezzo: "精霊と心を通わせ、神々の力の輪廻をひもとき生きる識者。厳然たる基礎事実の積み重ねを重視する科学者と対立する事が多い。"
en: A intellectual who communicates with spirits and lives through the circle of the gods' power. He is often at odds with scientists who emphasise the accumulation of rigorous basic facts.
en_grezzo: "A intellectual who communicates with spirits and lives through the circle of the gods' power. He is often at odds with scientists who emphasise the accumulation of rigorous basic facts. "
it: Un sapiente che comunica con gli spiriti e vive dipanando il ciclo eterno della forza delle divinità. Con gli scienziati, che tengono all'accumulo di fatti solidi e di base, si trova spesso in contrasto.

jp: 己の身体を鍛錬し、常人に抗し得ない活力で生活する者達。戦闘力に特化し、主に戦乱下において真価を発揮するため、平時には軍人、教官や、力仕事に就く事が多い。
jp_grezzo: "己の身体を鍛錬し、常人に抗し得ない活力で生活する者達。戦闘力に特化し、主に戦乱下において真価を発揮するため、平時には軍人、教官や、力仕事に就く事が多い。"
en: They are those who train their bodies and live with a vitality that ordinary people cannot resist. As they specialise in combat and mainly show their true value in times of war, they are often employed as soldiers, instructors or in hard work in times of peace.
en_grezzo: "They are those who train their bodies and live with a vitality that ordinary people cannot resist. As they specialise in combat and mainly show their true value in times of war, they are often employed as soldiers, instructors or in hard work in times of peace. "
it: Gente che tempra il proprio corpo e vive con un vigore a cui una persona comune non può opporsi. Sono specializzati nel combattimento e danno il meglio soprattutto in tempo di guerra, e così in tempo di pace fanno spesso i soldati, gli istruttori o i lavori di fatica.

jp: 土地の魔力を糧に成長した野菜に似たモンスター。多分に魔力を含んだ彼らの肉には冒険者の魔力を僅かながら刺激する効果がある。音属性の魔法でもある悲鳴に注意。
jp_grezzo: "土地の魔力を糧に成長した野菜に似たモンスター。多分に魔力を含んだ彼らの肉には冒険者の魔力を僅かながら刺激する効果がある。音属性の魔法でもある悲鳴に注意。"
en: A monster, resembling a vegetable, that grows by feeding on magical energy within the soil. Their flesh contains a large amount of magical energy, and is capable of stimulating the magical powers of those who consume it. Be wary of its terrifying screams, which are magic with the attribute of sound.
en_grezzo: "A monster, resembling a vegetable, that grows by feeding on magical energy within the soil. Their flesh contains a large amount of magical energy, and is capable of stimulating the magical powers of those who consume it. Be wary of its terrifying screams, which are magic with the attribute of sound."
it: Un mostro simile a un ortaggio, cresciuto nutrendosi della forza magica della terra. La sua carne, che di forza magica ne contiene parecchia, stimola un poco quella dell'avventuriero. Attenzione all'urlo, che è anche una magia dell'attributo suono.

jp: 街の子供の憧れな昆虫。乱獲によって大昔に野生のかぶと虫は絶滅したが、品種改良された個体が脱走し野生化している。越冬し、寿命も長い。
jp_grezzo: "街の子供の憧れな昆虫。乱獲によって大昔に野生のかぶと虫は絶滅したが、品種改良された個体が脱走し野生化している。越冬し、寿命も長い。"
en: Insects that are the dream of every child in the city. Wild beetles died out a long time ago due to overhunting, but bred individuals have escaped and are now in the wild. They survive over winter and have a long lifespan.
en_grezzo: "Insects that are the dream of every child in the city. Wild beetles died out a long time ago due to overhunting, but bred individuals have escaped and are now in the wild. They survive over winter and have a long lifespan."
it: L'insetto che tutti i bambini di città sognano. Quelli selvatici si sono estinti tanto tempo fa per la caccia sfrenata, ma certi esemplari selezionati sono scappati e sono tornati allo stato brado. Passa l'inverno e vive a lungo.

jp: オーク達の中でも特に勇猛で好戦的な者達。オークは手先が器用で機械にも興味を示すが、武器等の破壊をもたらす物以外を一切作ろうとしない。
jp_grezzo: "オーク達の中でも特に勇猛で好戦的な者達。オークは手先が器用で機械にも興味を示すが、武器等の破壊をもたらす物以外を一切作ろうとしない。"
en: Orcs are a tribe of particularly brave and warlike people. Orcs are very skillful with their hands and show interest in machinery, but they don't try to make anything other than weapons.
en_grezzo: "Orcs are a tribe of particularly brave and warlike people. Orcs are very skillful with their hands and show interest in machinery, but they don't try to make anything other than weapons."
it: Fra gli orchi, quelli particolarmente coraggiosi e bellicosi. Gli orchi hanno le mani buone e si interessano anche alle macchine, ma di costruire qualcosa che non porti distruzione, come le armi, non ne vogliono sapere.

jp: オーク族の歴戦の勇者。オークは決して愚かな存在では無いのだが鈍感で勝手なため、隊長となって部隊を纏めようとする者は非常に珍しい。
jp_grezzo: "オーク族の歴戦の勇者。オークは決して愚かな存在では無いのだが鈍感で勝手なため、隊長となって部隊を纏めようとする者は非常に珍しい。"
en: A brave warrior of the Orc tribe who has fought in many battles. Orcs are not stupid, but they are insensitive and self-indulgent, so it is very rare for them to become captains and try to unite their troops.
en_grezzo: "A brave warrior of the Orc tribe who has fought in many battles. Orcs are not stupid, but they are insensitive and self-indulgent, so it is very rare for them to become captains and try to unite their troops. "
it: Un valoroso della stirpe degli orchi, con molte battaglie alle spalle. Gli orchi non sono affatto stupidi, ma sono duri di sentimenti e fanno di testa loro, e perciò è rarissimo che uno diventi capitano e provi a tenere insieme un reparto.

jp: 埋葬された遺体に残されたマナが周囲の魔力に反応し、取り込むべく遺体を動かしている。稀に生前の意識が残っている個体も存在する。
jp_grezzo: "埋葬された遺体に残されたマナが周囲の魔力に反応し、取り込むべく遺体を動かしている。稀に生前の意識が残っている個体も存在する。"
en: A re-animated corpse brought to life by a reaction between mana left in its body and the mana in its surroundings. It's rare to find one that retains any memories of its life.
en_grezzo: "A re-animated corpse brought to life by a reaction between mana left in its body and the mana in its surroundings. It's rare to find one that retains any memories of its life."
it: Il mana rimasto nel corpo sepolto reagisce alla forza magica che ha intorno, e per assorbirla muove il cadavere. Di rado se ne trova uno che si porti dietro la coscienza di quando era vivo.

jp: 野外で良く見かける野生動物。素早い動きでひらりと身をかわす。超音波で周囲の状況がわかるため、盲目状態にならない。よく裏切るやつ、というイメージのせいで迷惑している。
jp_grezzo: "野外で良く見かける野生動物。素早い動きでひらりと身をかわす。超音波で周囲の状況がわかるため、盲目状態にならない。よく裏切るやつ、というイメージのせいで迷惑している。"
en: Wild animals often seen in the open. Dodges and dodges with quick movements. They use ultrasound to understand their surroundings, so they are not blind. They are inconvenienced by the inaccurate vision.
en_grezzo: "Wild animals often seen in the open. Dodges and dodges with quick movements. They use ultrasound to understand their surroundings, so they are not blind. They are inconvenienced by the inaccurate vision."
it: Un animale selvatico che si incontra spesso all'aperto. Con movimenti rapidi scarta e schiva. Grazie agli ultrasuoni sa che cosa gli sta intorno, e per questo non resta mai accecato. Gli dà fastidio la fama di essere uno che tradisce.

jp: コウモリの中でも吸血を行う種類の総称。ただしあまりお腹が膨れないため、吸血はおやつ感覚でしかないらしい。集団で獲物に群がり、血を吸い尽くしてしまう。
jp_grezzo: "コウモリの中でも吸血を行う種類の総称。ただしあまりお腹が膨れないため、吸血はおやつ感覚でしかないらしい。集団で獲物に群がり、血を吸い尽くしてしまう。"
en: A generic name for a species of bat that sucks blood. However, as their stomachs do not swell much, blood sucking is said to be only a snack. They swarm over their prey in groups and suck all the blood.
en_grezzo: "A generic name for a species of bat that sucks blood. However, as their stomachs do not swell much, blood sucking is said to be only a snack. They swarm over their prey in groups and suck all the blood."
it: Il nome che raccoglie le specie di pipistrello che succhiano il sangue. La pancia però non gli si riempie granché, e pare che il sangue sia poco più di uno spuntino. Si ammassano in gruppo sulla preda e le succhiano tutto il sangue.

jp: 竜のような翼を持つ戦闘能力の高い蝙蝠。その素早さに魅入られ、なんとかして乗馬しようとする者もいるという。ワイバーンに遭遇すると張り合おうとする習性がある。
jp_grezzo: "竜のような翼を持つ戦闘能力の高い蝙蝠。その素早さに魅入られ、なんとかして乗馬しようとする者もいるという。ワイバーンに遭遇すると張り合おうとする習性がある。"
en: A highly skilled bat with dragon-like wings. Some are said to be fascinated by its swiftness and try to ride it somehow. They have a habit of trying to compete with wyverns when they encounter them.
en_grezzo: "A highly skilled bat with dragon-like wings. Some are said to be fascinated by its swiftness and try to ride it somehow. They have a habit of trying to compete with wyverns when they encounter them."
it: Un pipistrello con le ali da drago e una buona capacità di combattere. C'è chi, incantato da quella rapidità, cerca in qualche modo di montarci sopra. Quando incontra una viverna ha l'abitudine di volersi misurare con lei.

jp: 美しい炎の花を咲かせたエント。動きはやや遅いものの高い生命力を誇り、その巨大な枝を振るう一撃はとても強烈である。
jp_grezzo: "美しい炎の花を咲かせたエント。動きはやや遅いものの高い生命力を誇り、その巨大な枝を振るう一撃はとても強烈である。"
en: Ent with beautiful flame flowers. Although it moves rather slowly, it boasts high vitality and the strikes it delivers with its huge branches are very powerful.
en_grezzo: "Ent with beautiful flame flowers. Although it moves rather slowly, it boasts high vitality and the strikes it delivers with its huge branches are very powerful. "
it: Un Ent che ha aperto bellissimi fiori di fiamma. Si muove piuttosto lento, ma vanta una gran forza vitale, e il colpo che sferra con quei rami enormi è violentissimo.

jp: 美しい氷の花を咲かせたエント。冷気に包まれた幹や枝は水晶のように輝いており、観賞用として貴族の間で人気が高い。
jp_grezzo: "美しい氷の花を咲かせたエント。冷気に包まれた幹や枝は水晶のように輝いており、観賞用として貴族の間で人気が高い。"
en: Ent with beautiful ice flowers. The trunks and branches, surrounded by cold air, shine like crystals and are popular among the nobility as ornamental plants.
en_grezzo: "Ent with beautiful ice flowers. The trunks and branches, surrounded by cold air, shine like crystals and are popular among the nobility as ornamental plants. "
it: Un Ent che ha aperto bellissimi fiori di ghiaccio. Il tronco e i rami, avvolti nel gelo, brillano come cristallo, e fra i nobili sono molto ricercati come ornamento.

jp: 生前は魔術士だった者が死してなお現世にしがみつこうとした成れの果て。理性の残っていない者は人に害をもたらす仇敵となる。
jp_grezzo: "生前は魔術士だった者が死してなお現世にしがみつこうとした成れの果て。理性の残っていない者は人に害をもたらす仇敵となる。"
en: The result of those who were mages in life and tried to cling to this world even after death. Those who have no reason left become avengers who bring harm to others.
en_grezzo: "The result of those who were mages in life and tried to cling to this world even after death. Those who have no reason left become avengers who bring harm to others. "
it: Quel che resta di chi in vita era un mago e, anche da morto, ha voluto restare aggrappato a questo mondo. Chi non ha più un briciolo di ragione diventa un nemico che porta danno agli uomini.

jp: 肉体を失い霊体化が進んできたリッチ。長き時の中で永遠を求めた過去の記憶は既に磨耗してしまっており、道行く生者を同じ存在に落とそうとする魔物と化している。
jp_grezzo: "肉体を失い霊体化が進んできたリッチ。長き時の中で永遠を求めた過去の記憶は既に磨耗してしまっており、道行く生者を同じ存在に落とそうとする魔物と化している。"
en: Lich, who has lost his physical body and has been transformed into a spirit body. The memories of the past, which sought eternity in the long passage of time, have already worn away, and he has become a monster who tries to reduce the living in his path to the same existence.
en_grezzo: "Lich, who has lost his physical body and has been transformed into a spirit body. The memories of the past, which sought eternity in the long passage of time, have already worn away, and he has become a monster who tries to reduce the living in his path to the same existence. "
it: Un lich che ha perso il corpo e si è fatto via via spirito. Il ricordo di quando, nel lungo scorrere del tempo, cercava l'eternità si è ormai consumato, e si è ridotto a un mostro che vuole portare alla propria condizione i vivi che incontra.

jp: 肉体が崩れ落ち半霊の存在となったリッチ。久遠の年月を彷徨い続けた結果、驚異的な魔力と引き換えに本能のみで生者を殺害しようとする悪霊となった。
jp_grezzo: "肉体が崩れ落ち半霊の存在となったリッチ。久遠の年月を彷徨い続けた結果、驚異的な魔力と引き換えに本能のみで生者を殺害しようとする悪霊となった。"
en: Lich, whose physical body collapsed and he became a half-spirit. As a result of his wandering through the ages, he became an evil spirit that tries to kill the living with only his instincts in exchange for his amazing magical powers.
en_grezzo: "Lich, whose physical body collapsed and he became a half-spirit. As a result of his wandering through the ages, he became an evil spirit that tries to kill the living with only his instincts in exchange for his amazing magical powers. "
it: Un lich il cui corpo si è sgretolato e che è diventato mezzo spirito. A furia di vagare per età intere è diventato uno spirito maligno che, in cambio di una forza magica prodigiosa, cerca di uccidere i vivi per solo istinto.

jp: 死に通ずる冥界の魔物。生きることが罪であるという生者と相いれない価値観を持ち、相手を強制的に殺害する恐ろしい呪いで一方的に刑を執行する。
jp_grezzo: "死に通ずる冥界の魔物。生きることが罪であるという生者と相いれない価値観を持ち、相手を強制的に殺害する恐ろしい呪いで一方的に刑を執行する。"
en: A monster of the underworld that is connected to death. It has values that are incompatible with those of the living, which state that to live is a sin, and unilaterally executes sentences with a terrible curse that forcibly kills its opponents.
en_grezzo: "A monster of the underworld that is connected to death. It has values that are incompatible with those of the living, which state that to live is a sin, and unilaterally executes sentences with a terrible curse that forcibly kills its opponents. "
it: Un mostro dell'oltretomba che porta alla morte. Ha valori che con quelli dei vivi non stanno insieme, e cioè che vivere sia una colpa, ed esegue la sentenza da solo, con una maledizione tremenda che uccide per forza chi ha davanti.

jp: 死に通ずる冥界の魔物。生者と死者の数の帳尻を合わせるために、彼らは死神の命令で死の宣告を行う。たいていは本来迎えるはずの死ではないため、返り討ちにすればなかったことにできる。
jp_grezzo: "死に通ずる冥界の魔物。生者と死者の数の帳尻を合わせるために、彼らは死神の命令で死の宣告を行う。たいていは本来迎えるはずの死ではないため、返り討ちにすればなかったことにできる。"
en: A monster of the underworld that is connected to death. In order to balance the numbers of the living and the dead, they are ordered by the god of death to declare death sentences. Most of the time, the death is not the death that should have come, so it can be pretended that it never happened if the victim survives.
en_grezzo: "A monster of the underworld that is connected to death. In order to balance the numbers of the living and the dead, they are ordered by the god of death to declare death sentences. Most of the time, the death is not the death that should have come, so it can be pretended that it never happened if the victim survives."
it: Un mostro dell'oltretomba che porta alla morte. Per far tornare i conti fra il numero dei vivi e quello dei morti, pronunciano la condanna per ordine della Morte. Quasi sempre non è la morte che sarebbe davvero toccata, e quindi, se lo si respinge, la cosa si può cancellare.

jp: 獲物を狩ることに特化している犬。犬は縄張り意識が強いために、自分より強いレベルの犬がいる場所には住み着くことはない。
jp_grezzo: "獲物を狩ることに特化している犬。犬は縄張り意識が強いために、自分より強いレベルの犬がいる場所には住み着くことはない。"
en: Dogs specialize in hunting prey. Because dogs are territorial, they will not settle in areas where there are dogs on a stronger level than themselves.
en_grezzo: "Dogs specialize in hunting prey. Because dogs are territorial, they will not settle in areas where there are dogs on a stronger level than themselves."
it: Un cane specializzato nel dare la caccia alla preda. I cani hanno un forte senso del territorio, e non si stabiliscono dove c'è un cane di livello più forte del loro.

jp: 火炎の息吹を放つ犬。放たれる炎はインド象を一瞬で丸焼きにしてしまうほど。熱に強いのは頭部や毛皮だけであり、肉は普通に焼くことができる。
jp_grezzo: "火炎の息吹を放つ犬。放たれる炎はインド象を一瞬で丸焼きにしてしまうほど。熱に強いのは頭部や毛皮だけであり、肉は普通に焼くことができる。"
en: A dog that unleashes a breath of flame. The flames it releases can roast an Indian elephant whole in an instant. Only their heads and fur are resistant to heat; meat can be roasted normally.
en_grezzo: "A dog that unleashes a breath of flame. The flames it releases can roast an Indian elephant whole in an instant. Only their heads and fur are resistant to heat; meat can be roasted normally."
it: Un cane che manda un soffio di fiamma. Le fiamme che sprigiona arrostiscono un elefante indiano intero in un istante. A resistere al calore però sono soltanto la testa e la pelliccia: la carne si cuoce come quella di tutti.

jp: 帯びたものを氷結させる息吹を放つ犬。インド象の縄張りに侵入し、手当たり次第に氷漬けにするほど狂暴で迷惑な奴。でも夏になると途端に人気が出る。
jp_grezzo: "帯びたものを氷結させる息吹を放つ犬。インド象の縄張りに侵入し、手当たり次第に氷漬けにするほど狂暴で迷惑な奴。でも夏になると途端に人気が出る。"
en: A dog that releases breath that freezes anything it is girdled with. He is so rabid and annoying that he invades Indian elephant territory and freezes them at random. But he is instantly popular in summer.
en_grezzo: "A dog that releases breath that freezes anything it is girdled with. He is so rabid and annoying that he invades Indian elephant territory and freezes them at random. But he is instantly popular in summer."
it: Un cane che manda un soffio capace di congelare quello che investe. È talmente rabbioso e molesto che entra nel territorio degli elefanti indiani e li mette sotto ghiaccio a casaccio. D'estate, però, di colpo diventa popolare.

jp: 雷撃を帯びた息吹を放つ犬。水浴びをしているインド象を感電死させることで有名。いくら電気に強い装備をしていてもまともに息吹を浴びれば少しの間痺れてしまう。
jp_grezzo: "雷撃を帯びた息吹を放つ犬。水浴びをしているインド象を感電死させることで有名。いくら電気に強い装備をしていてもまともに息吹を浴びれば少しの間痺れてしまう。"
en: Dogs that release lightning-breath tinged breath. Famous for electrocuting Indian elephants bathing in water. No matter how much electricity-resistant equipment you have, you will be paralysed for a short while if you are exposed to the breath.
en_grezzo: "Dogs that release lightning-breath tinged breath. Famous for electrocuting Indian elephants bathing in water. No matter how much electricity-resistant equipment you have, you will be paralysed for a short while if you are exposed to the breath."
it: Un cane che manda un soffio carico di fulmini. È famoso per fulminare gli elefanti indiani mentre fanno il bagno. Per quanto tu abbia un equipaggiamento che resiste all'elettricità, se ti prendi il soffio in pieno resti intorpidito per un poco.

jp: 暗黒をもたらす息吹を放つ犬。対象が見えなければ多くの魔法は発動できないため、多くの魔法使いの天敵と言える。性格もダークで、かわいそうなインド象をもそそのかし暗黒面に叩き落とすという。
jp_grezzo: "暗黒をもたらす息吹を放つ犬。対象が見えなければ多くの魔法は発動できないため、多くの魔法使いの天敵と言える。性格もダークで、かわいそうなインド象をもそそのかし暗黒面に叩き落とすという。"
en: A dog that releases breath that brings darkness. It is the natural enemy of many wizards, as it cannot perform many of its magic if it cannot see its target. It has a dark personality and is said to seduce poor Indian elephants and bring them down to the dark side.
en_grezzo: "A dog that releases breath that brings darkness. It is the natural enemy of many wizards, as it cannot perform many of its magic if it cannot see its target. It has a dark personality and is said to seduce poor Indian elephants and bring them down to the dark side."
it: Un cane che manda un soffio che porta il buio. Se non vede il bersaglio un mago non può lanciare quasi nessuna magia, e per questo è il nemico naturale di tanti maghi. Ha un carattere oscuro anche lui, e si dice che tenti perfino i poveri elefanti indiani per farli cadere nel lato oscuro.

jp: 幻覚成分を含む息吹を放つ犬。その息吹は少し吸い込むだけでインド象でも昏倒してしまう。混乱した獲物がふらふらになる様を眺めるのが好きらしい。
jp_grezzo: "幻覚成分を含む息吹を放つ犬。その息吹は少し吸い込むだけでインド象でも昏倒してしまう。混乱した獲物がふらふらになる様を眺めるのが好きらしい。"
en: Dogs that release breath containing hallucinogenic ingredients. The breath can cause even an Indian elephant to fall into a stupor if it inhales just a little. They like to watch their confused prey become flustered.
en_grezzo: "Dogs that release breath containing hallucinogenic ingredients. The breath can cause even an Indian elephant to fall into a stupor if it inhales just a little. They like to watch their confused prey become flustered."
it: Un cane che manda un soffio pieno di sostanze che danno le allucinazioni. Basta respirarne un poco perché anche un elefante indiano stramazzi. Pare che gli piaccia guardare la preda confusa che barcolla.

jp: 神経を麻痺させる息吹を放つ犬。麻痺して動けなくなった獲物に思う存分食らいつく戦法をとる。インド象であろうと息吹を吸い込んでしまったら卒倒は免れない。
jp_grezzo: "神経を麻痺させる息吹を放つ犬。麻痺して動けなくなった獲物に思う存分食らいつく戦法をとる。インド象であろうと息吹を吸い込んでしまったら卒倒は免れない。"
en: A dog that releases a breath that paralyses the nerves. It will bite its paralysed, immobilised prey to its heart's content. Even an Indian elephant cannot escape a stroke if it inhales the breath.
en_grezzo: "A dog that releases a breath that paralyses the nerves. It will bite its paralysed, immobilised prey to its heart's content. Even an Indian elephant cannot escape a stroke if it inhales the breath."
it: Un cane che manda un soffio che paralizza i nervi. La sua tattica è addentare a sazietà la preda paralizzata e immobile. Anche un elefante indiano, se respira quel soffio, non scampa allo svenimento.

jp: 猛毒の息吹を放つ犬。その毒は致命的ではないものの、時間とともに確実に命を蝕む。記録によれば、インド象の多くがこの毒によって命を落としたとされている。
jp_grezzo: "猛毒の息吹を放つ犬。その毒は致命的ではないものの、時間とともに確実に命を蝕む。記録によれば、インド象の多くがこの毒によって命を落としたとされている。"
en: The dog releases a highly poisonous breath. The poison is not fatal, but it certainly eats away at their lives over time. Records indicate that many Indian elephants have lost their lives to this poison.
en_grezzo: "The dog releases a highly poisonous breath. The poison is not fatal, but it certainly eats away at their lives over time. Records indicate that many Indian elephants have lost their lives to this poison."
it: Un cane che manda un soffio velenosissimo. Il veleno non è fatale, ma con il tempo consuma la vita di sicuro. Secondo le cronache, tanti elefanti indiani hanno perso la vita per questo veleno.
